# Isolated beta.5 visual fixture

Generated by tools/generate_crops5_fixture.py for a separate QA world.
Rows z=0/4/8/12/16: vine, glow lichen, twisting vines, weeping vines, big dripleaf.
Four comparison stages at x=0/2/4/6 use artificial 600000-tick durations.
They preserve intermediate stages for comparison and do not prove real timing.
Manual machines at x=12 and automatic machines at x=16 use real 600-tick cycles.
Automatic machines export into chests below them.

Hotbar 1: overview. 2–6: the five manual machines. 7/8: vine/lichen stages.
9: vine export chest. Drop the selected camera item before free teleports.
Other stage rows: `/tp @s 3.5 120 11 180 18` (twisting), then z=15/19.
Other chests: `/tp @s 16.5 120 6.5 180 40`, then z=10.5/14.5/18.5.
Use is bound to G only in the isolated test profile. No QA JAR is required.

Drop the selected camera item before opening the target. Continuous fixture
teleports can prevent Use from reaching the server. The production JAR does
not include this camera fixture.
